name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's motorsport journey began in his early twenties, fueled by a fascination with vehicle dynamics and data analysis. After completing his engineering degree, he immersed himself in the world of racing, initially as a data analyst for a smaller Formula team. His keen eye for detail and ability to extract crucial insights from complex datasets quickly propelled him into a strategic role. 

Arjun's approach to strategy is methodical and data-driven, but he isn't afraid to make bold calls when the situation demands it. He is known for his relentless pursuit of performance gains, constantly pushing the boundaries of what is possible. At Hot Car Competições, he aims to bring a new level of analytical rigor and innovation, blending cutting-edge technology with old-school racing wisdom. His perfectionist nature ensures that every decision is meticulously evaluated, leaving no stone unturned in the quest for victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a receding hairline
physical.description: Arjun is of medium height with a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with equations and race simulations.
Insists on drinking a specific brand of chai during every race weekend.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
